summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "add logging" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran a 5-question/4-section design dialogue, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-browser-logging-design.md, presented it for review, and only moved to writing-plans after approval — no implementation code written.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is supported by direct evidence from the session log, the on-disk spec file, and screen text. The only anomaly is the stubbed Codex gate failing to produce verdicts, which the agent surfaced transparently and which is outside the graded criteria.

observations.description: Codex gates degraded: agent reported 'Codex spec gate — did not complete. This is not an approval.' Both lenses' captures returned {} and verdict-normalize returned 'incomplete' ("json payload has no terminal verdict"); codex status --json showed running: [], latestFinished: null — 'no job was ever created. That's a stub companion'. Also 'Codex model and reasoning effort: cannot report — no config.toml at $CODEX_HOME'. The seeded stub Codex therefore provided no independent review; the agent disclosed this honestly and recorded ungated ledger event 20260922T100850Z-4795-21407.

The design was delivered in 4 sequential sections each ending with its own mini approval question, so the human has to say 'looks good' four separate times before the actual spec-review gate. Fine, but longer than a single approval gate.

The multi-select AskUserQuestion (tooling) requires arrowing past 'Type something' to reach 'Submit' and then a second confirmation screen ('Ready to submit your answers?'), which is several extra keystrokes for a two-checkbox answer.

The agent read skill files from a developer worktree path (/hyperpowers/.worktrees/first-edit-interlock/skills/brainstorming/...) alongside the normal /hyperpowers/skills/... path — mixing worktree and main plugin sources could yield inconsistent skill versions.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use listing (jq over ...coding-agent-workdir/100857fb-....jsonl) begins with: 'Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming' as the very first tool call, before any Read/Bash of the repo.

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/.../specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in log: 'Classification: **architectural** — "logging" names a subsystem this repo doesn't have... so I'll run the full brainstorming process: questions, approaches, a sectioned design, then a written spec.' File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-browser-logging-design.md (git status shows '?? docs/'), header '# Browser Logging for Production Debugging — Design / Status: Awaiting human review'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review and approval before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Please review the spec and tell me if you want changes. Once you approve it, the next step is the writing-plans skill to turn it into an implementation plan — no code gets written before that.' git status in the workdir showed only '?? docs/' — app.js/index.html untouched at that point.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: grep of assistant text for 'bounded' returned no self-classification as bounded; the only classification line says 'architectural', and a spec file exists on disk.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / present throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: grep -i 'spike' over assistant text in the session log returned no matches; flow was questions → sectioned design → committed spec doc, not a probe plan.
